title: Babric Vein Mine
description: Hold LEFT CTRL while breaking a whitelisted block to mine the entire connected vein. Singleplayer only.
body: A simple Babric port to mine veins of ore/blocks. Hold LEFT CTRL while breaking a whitelisted block to mine the entire connected vein. Singleplayer only. Block IDs can be added to the config file, along with maximum blocks mined.
